markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Unflagged tier-1 simulated frozen section with single-class conformal set [F1] and clear margins [F11], though cell counts conflict.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 100%, Normal/InSitu/Invasive 0% | Strong benign call; 0% invasive risk |
| Conformal set | {Benign} (alpha 10%; 90% test coverage) | Single class at 90% dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability; 76th OOD percentile [F6] | Typical image; all 12 regions kept |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree (true) | Both models share top class |
| Similar cases | 4/5 Benign (80%), 1/5 Normal [F5] | Neighbors favor Benign or Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 9) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.82, contrib -1.21) pushes away from invasion [F2] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 0, 5, 8) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (+1.61, contrib -0.69) favors benign architecture [F3] · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 2) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.05, contrib +0.44) slightly raises invasive score [F4] · Validated
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 2) · ↑ invasive · Contrib +0.38 pushes upward, but scored 0/20 on AI spot-check · Unreliable
- **Neoplastic nuclei segmentation** (regions 1, 6, 10) · context · 89% tumor fraction (100th percentile) [F7], 2883/mm² [F8], 48 µm² nuclei [F9] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful in dataset deletion tests (top-3 drop +0.0114 vs random; 95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197 excludes 0).
- **Concepts**: Unproven by deletion (+0.0008; CI -0.0088 to 0.0064 includes 0); ignore Unreliable normal_lobules (0/20), mitoses (0/20), necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- HoVer-Net neoplastic calls in regions 1 and 10 (238, 141 nuclei) reflect small-cell carcinoma, not benign epithelium [F10].
- Simulated frozen-section appearance masks invasion, or tissue is Normal like contrast case BACH_0381 (86% similar).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 1, 10**: Verify whether dense 48 µm² nuclei (238 and 141 neoplastic calls) are benign epithelium.
2. **Region 6**: Inspect the lone nonzero risk tile (0.001), highest TIL score, and 19 neoplastic calls.
3. **Regions 0, 2, 5, 8, 9**: Confirm benign tubules (0, 5, 8) and absent stromal invasion (2, 9).
